question: Does any code remain in apps/web (src, convex, convex/ai/prompts/library, e2e support code that ships) that infers the encounter status/type from dictation or photo text: classifyEncounterType, legacyInferEncounterType, the prompt encounter/encounter-type.md, writes of encTypeSource from text, regexes over 'admission'/'consult' that set the badge? For each remaining piece say whether anything calls it, and whether it is reachable from the shipped app (client or a Convex function the app calls) or only from evaluation scripts / tests.

rule.pass: no code reads the status out of dictation or photo text anywhere, whether or not anything calls it

answers.answer:
The status-from-text code is disconnected, but it has not been removed. Four pieces remain at e02167f:

1. **`legacyInferEncounterType`** (convex/lib/encounterType.ts) still holds its regexes over "new admission", "admission note" and similar phrases. Only e2e/unit/encounter-type-set.unit.ts calls it.
2. **`ai/parsing.classifyEncounterType`** is still exported as a public aiAction (an authenticated Convex `action`). It asks the model to read the visit type out of dictation, with helpers `buildEncounterTypeContent`, `readEncounterTypeReply` and `classifyEncounterContent` beside it. Its only caller is e2e/api/encounter-type.live.spec.ts. Nothing in src/ calls it, and it writes nothing.
3. **The prompt `encounter/encounter-type.md`** ("Classify today's hospital visit … from the physician's own dictation") is still in the library and compiled into generated.ts.
4. **`encTypeSource`** remains only as a schema field. The comment says nothing reads or writes it.

Nothing the shipped app runs writes `encType` from text:
- The census scan hardcodes "follow-up".
- Add Patient, Add Resident and the patient screens set it only from the physician's own choice.
- The regexes in src/ that mention "admission" (recall.ts, grounding.ts) do not set the status.

The Then says no such code should exist even if nothing calls it, so the code does not meet it. Every remaining piece is reached only by evaluation scripts or tests, so under the oracle's default each one is pending:Q4 rather than a plain fail. No recorded gap applies.

Code that reads the encounter status out of dictation is still in apps/web at e02167f, so the Then ("no code reads the status out of dictation or photo text, whether or not anything calls it") is not met. Three pieces remain:
(1) `legacyInferEncounterType` in convex/lib/encounterType.ts. This is the old keyword/regex matcher over phrases like 'new admission', 'admitted today' and 'follow-up visit'. The code marks it "TESTS ONLY", and only e2e/unit/encounter-type-set.unit.ts calls it.
(2) The model classifier `classifyEncounterType` in convex/ai/parsing.ts, with its helpers in convex/lib/encounterType.ts. It is a public Convex action (`aiAction` wraps `action`) and is deployed with the backend. Nothing in apps/web/src calls it. Only e2e/api/encounter-type.live.spec.ts and the e2e/support/actions.ts argument table call it. It returns a label and never writes `encType` or `encTypeSource`.
(3) The prompt library/v1/encounter/encounter-type.md, which is still compiled into generated.ts and listed in prompts.lock.json.
Nothing writes `encTypeSource` from text. The census photo scan hard-codes encType "follow-up" and does not infer it. Every remaining piece is reached only by evaluation scripts or tests, so under the oracle's default each one is pending:Q4 rather than a plain fail. If Q4 decides that evaluation-only code counts, the verdict becomes fail.

physicianImpact: A physician's status badge never changes because of what they dictate or photograph; it changes only when they set it. The leftover classifier, regexes and prompt are dead code that the app never runs. They could only come back into use if someone wires them in again. / None today: physicians still choose the admission status themselves, and no app path changes the badge from dictation or photo text. Text-based classifier code and its prompt remain deployed. A signed-in user could call the classifier action directly, but it only returns a label and writes nothing.
